items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Griffin was around, and then we did an album with Ira and Griffin, where they changed saxes and all.

ctx.x: After he came off the Hampton band, because he came off very early, he was just seventeen or eighteen. And Griffin was around, and then we did an album with Ira and Griffin, where they changed saxes and all. Baritone, alto, and tenor, and then Ira also played trumpet and flugelhorn. Griffin has the same birthday as me, April 24th, as did Joe Henderson, and I happened to get them both together one time at the Blackstone Hotel. Pardon me for saying it, but it was no contest.
